title: The Carpenter's Trade
html:
Hollis Tamber patches every boat that ties up at Plymouth Wharf, and he has more hulls than hours.

About

Given byHollis Tamber
Level5
LengthShort
KindSkill unlocks
Quest points1
UnlocksThe Carpentry skill

What you need

  • Pine Plank ×10
  • Iron Fittings ×5

Steps

  1. Talk to Hollis Tamber (outdoors near Plymouth Wharf) to get the quest.
  2. Saw 10 Pine Planks at the sawmill in Hollis Tamber's yard at Plymouth Wharf and bring them to him.
  3. Hammer out 5 sets of Iron Fittings at the anvil in Hollis Tamber's yard and bring them to him.
  4. Speak with Hollis Tamber at Plymouth Wharf to finish the quest.

What Hollis Tamber says

Hollis Tamber: Here's a saw and twenty pine logs. Hold the saw in your off hand and run the logs through the sawmill, two to a plank. I want ten. The hammer and the ore are for later.

Hollis Tamber: Straight enough. Now the ironwork. Take the hammer to that ore at the anvil, one ore to a set, and bring me five sets of fittings.

Hollis Tamber: Good. You'll want a lot more of both before you build anything of your own.

Hollis Tamber: That's the trade. Planks at the sawmill, fittings at the anvil. The finer woods and metals come with practice.
